attributes.action: Call a General Election before any new Prime Minister is installed into Office
attributes.additional_details:
Sir Keir Starmer has resigned as Prime Minister. 
We believe the British Public, not just MPs, should choose his successor. 

We call on the UK Government to hold a General Election now, instead of installing a New Prime Minister to take office without the General British Public voting for them.
attributes.background: The Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer has resigned. We ask the UK Government to call a General Election rather than let an installation of a new PM take office without a public vote, so the British people - not just MPs decide who leads the country thus Honouring Democracy!

rejection.details:
